title: Applet misleadingly says "no vaults have been set up" instead of a real error message when kded module wasn't loaded is or crashing
line: The Vaults applet now says when its background service isn't running, and shows your vaults again once it is back, instead of claiming none have been set up.
explanation: The applet asks the plasmavault kded module for its vaults over D-Bus, but when that call failed the model just returned, so the list stayed empty and the applet showed 'No Vaults have been set up'. After a kded crash KCrash restarts kded, which takes its D-Bus name before the module exists, so the applet's reload right then failed and it never asked again. The model now tracks whether the service answered, retries a few times, and also retries when the popup is opened; the applet shows 'Vaults are unavailable' with a Try Again button and uses the error icon while the service is missing.

commits.message:
applet: show an error when the Vaults service is unavailable

When the kded module wasn't reachable, the model silently ignored the
failed D-Bus call and the applet claimed no vaults had been set up. The
model now tracks this, retries a few times, and the applet says so.

BUG: 446437

media.caption: Master: after kded6 crashes and KCrash restarts it, the applet claims no vaults are set up although 'Here' exists
With the fix: same crash, the applet lists 'Here' again
Master: with kded6 not running, the applet says no vaults are set up and offers to create one
With the fix: kded6 not running gives 'Vaults are unavailable' with Try Again and a red tray icon
